We define continuity for vector functions the same way we define continuity for scalar functions defined over an interval.
DEFINITION A vector function r(t) is continuous at a point t = t0 in its domain if limtSt0r(t) = r(t0). The function is continuous if it is continuous over its interval domain.
From Equation (3), we see that r(t) is continuous at t = t0 if and only if each compo- nent function is continuous there (Exercise 31).
